prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting:

- `type ShipmentStage = "queued" | "held" | "sent"`
- `interface Shipment { readonly code: string; readonly description: string; readonly stage: ShipmentStage; readonly feeCents: number }`
- `interface ShipmentSummary { queued: number; held: number; sent: number }`
- `queueAll(shipments: readonly Shipment[]): Shipment[]`
- `holdAll(shipments: readonly Shipment[]): Shipment[]`
- `summarizeShipments(shipments: readonly Shipment[]): ShipmentSummary`
- `formatShipment(shipment: Shipment): string`

The two bulk functions must return a new array containing new objects in the original order, changing only `stage`. They must never mutate or reuse an input shipment object. Empty arrays produce fresh empty arrays.

`summarizeShipments` returns all three counters, including zero counters, and must not mutate its input. `formatShipment` returns exactly `"<code> | <description> | <stage> | <fee>"`, where `<fee>` is `feeCents / 100` formatted with exactly two decimal digits. Assume callers provide finite integer `feeCents`, including zero and negative values.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
